entities.title: README says every response gets a session id
entities.summary: The README's "Session ids and dedupe" says every response starts with `[r:ID]` when a session is set, but only successful find, read, ls, outline and refs answers (and read-again) get a session id; clean and `zazzle run` answers carry an output id instead, with or without a session.
entities.expected: The README says which answers carry a session `[r:ID]`: successful find, read, ls, outline and refs answers and read-again, not edits, errors, status, help or version; and that clean, run and proxy outputs carry an output id of their own (its Stored outputs section).
entities.observed: "With ZAZZLE_SESSION set (or over MCP, where each connection is a session) every response starts with `[r:ID]`." The code gives a session id only to outputs built with Output::ok (find, read, ls, outline, refs); clean, edit, status, help, version and every error use Output::plain or Output::err, which carry none. (The same section does say edits are never deduplicated, and points to Stored outputs for clean, run and proxy.)
reproduction: With ZAZZLE_SESSION set, run `zazzle status` or `zazzle edit FILE --old a --new b --expect SHA`.

origin.by: Coding agent documenting the daemon for HASD; re-checked against today's code when the .dev files were reconciled after the rename to zazzled, and again after commit 5ea503c (stored outputs)

entities.title: README's test command names a make target that does not exist
entities.summary: The README's Tests section says to run `make unit coverage smoke` in macos/c/zazzle, but the Makefile has no `smoke` target; the smoke test is `sh test/smoke.sh`.
entities.expected: A command that runs the invoker's unit tests, coverage gate and smoke test, such as `make unit coverage && sh test/smoke.sh` (as AGENTS.md and the invoker's README give it).
entities.observed: `make unit coverage smoke` runs the unit tests and the coverage gate, then stops with `make: *** No rule to make target 'smoke'.` The Makefile's targets are all, unit, coverage and clean.
reproduction: make reports that there is no rule to make target `smoke`.

origin.by: Coding agent reconciling the daemon's .dev files and README with the code after the rename
